name: Kago no Naka no Kanojo
source:
Yujiro is an elite adult game player. One day, a girl moves to a next room. Her name is Mamiko. She is acutually a famous voice actress. Of course, Yujiro knows her. However, he also knows that Mamiko works as a voice actress for adult games.... "She must be a much better voice actress for adult games...." Days later, he sneaks into her room and steals all her underwears. What Mamiko sees when she wakes up is Yujiro standing naked in front of her....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
Yujiro是一名资深成人游戏玩家。一天，一名叫Mamiko的女孩搬到隔壁。她其实是一位知名声优，Yujiro当然认识她；他也知道Mamiko还为成人游戏配音…“她为成人游戏配音时一定更加出色…”几天后，他潜入Mamiko的房间，偷走她所有内衣。Mamiko醒来时，看见的是赤身裸体站在面前的Yujiro…

[摘自ErogeShop]
